Hi Priya,

We're planning a database migration for NovaCorp's production inference traffic during our maintenance window on Oct 17-19 (02:00–05:00 UTC nightly). To reduce the risk of noisy/automatic P1 escalations while we run the cutover scripts, can Redwood grant a temporary adjustment to the support response windows for P2 incidents overnight?

- Dates: 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-19
- Window: 02:00–05:00 UTC each night
- Change: P2 response target relaxed from 2 hours to 4 hours during this window (P1 commitments unchanged)

We will provide a runbook and a dedicated Slack channel during the migration. Procurement will need a formal exception PDF for our records. Attaching the migration plan (attachment: migration-plan.pdf).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can support this limited temporary exemption and what approvals are required?

Thanks,

3) Any specific thresholds that would still force an immediate P1 (e.g., >99.5% error rate)?

Thanks, Priya / Anna. We can support a temporary carveout with guardrails. Operational points from our side:
- We'll enable stricter alert thresholds during the window and route escalations through a dedicated rotation (Ben + on-call infra).
- Suggest a fallback routing to a lower-cost model variant for traffic spikes to avoid broad P1s.
